# SMTP Gotchas

> SMTP submission-server, message-parsing and SASL gotchas.

## Entries

- [A mail parser and a downstream reader can disagree about where the header section ends, so a second From passes a single-From check](header-section-end-disagreement-lets-a-second-from-through.md): `mail-parser` ends the header section at a line holding only a form feed while other software reads on, so a second From naming another sender passes the ownership check and is sent DKIM-signed; validate the header section at the byte level and require agreement with the parser (it also decodes encoded-words inside angle brackets). HIGH.
- [smtp-proto 0.2.5: the request parser and DATA receiver accept or rewrite input in ways a server must not rely on](smtp-proto-0-2-5-request-parser-and-data-receiver-quirks.md): No line-length bound, CRs deleted anywhere in a line, `<postmaster>` and `<>` both parse as the empty address, quotes dropped from local parts, an over-long SIZE wraps to a small number, DATA ends on `.\r\r\n` and not on a first line of `.`; frame lines and read DATA yourself, treat SIZE as advisory. HIGH.
- [Never normalise or forward a bare CR or LF in message data (SMTP smuggling)](bare-cr-or-lf-in-message-data-smtp-smuggling.md): End of data is exactly CRLF.CRLF; refuse a message containing a bare CR or LF, and close the connection when a dot line sits next to one. HIGH.
- [Deciding authorization once at AUTH lets a revoked credential keep sending on an open session, and an idle timer restarted by any byte defeats slowloris protection](authorization-decided-once-at-auth-outlives-revocation.md): Re-check the credential at each MAIL FROM and before each send, bound session lifetime, and count refused commands so they cannot serve as keep-alives; use deadlines for a whole command, not a timer any byte restarts. HIGH.
- [Answering the final dot only after post-send bookkeeping lets a slow store or a shutdown turn an accepted message into a client retry (duplicate)](answer-250-when-the-relay-accepts-not-after-bookkeeping.md): Once SES has accepted the message a slow store or shutdown before the 250 makes the client resubmit; answer 250 as soon as the relay accepts and record in a task the shutdown drain waits for. MEDIUM.
- [SASL OAUTHBEARER / XOAUTH2 interop facts: RFC 7628's example GS2 header is invalid, XOAUTH2 clients acknowledge failure with an empty line, and fuzz targets need a seeded corpus](sasl-oauthbearer-xoauth2-interop-facts.md): Do not use the RFC 7628 section 4.4 example as a strict-parser vector; accept an empty line as the XOAUTH2 failure acknowledgement as well as `AQ==`; Google's failure JSON carries HTTP status strings; seed the fuzz corpus with valid initial responses. MEDIUM.
